title: Stabilize header save badge layout + compact Vault publishing UI with hover tooltips

requirements.text: Prevent the save-status badge (e.g., “Saving…”, “Saved”) displayed to the right of the project name in the header from causing any horizontal layout shift/jitter when it appears/disappears, while keeping it in the same position (right side of the project name) on desktop and in the mobile menu project header.

quotes: Please fix the notification right next to the project name; it's making the navigation bar move, which is very annoying.
Stay in the same position (right side of project name) but simply stop shifting the layout

acceptanceCriteria: Toggling saveStatus between idle/saving/saved does not change the header’s overall width, spacing, or cause nav items to move on desktop.
Toggling saveStatus does not cause the mobile menu’s project header row (project name/blockchain/save status) to shift.
The save status remains visually located to the right of the project name (not moved to a different header area).

requirements.text: Redesign the Vault publishing instructions so they do not take up extra vertical space: remove the always-visible instructional text block under the Lock/Unlock/Upload buttons and replace it with hover tooltips on the Lock, Unlock, and Upload buttons that display the provided explanations.

quotes:
Redesign the VAULT page so that the instructions above don't take up too much space.
(Lock: Prevents regeneration and enables upload.
Unlock: Allows regeneration but clears upload status.
Upload: Uploads images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata.)
hover tooltips (When you hover your mouse over the buttons (Lock, unlock, upload))

acceptanceCriteria: The Vault page no longer shows the three-line help text block describing Lock/Unlock/Upload below the publishing controls.

Hovering each button shows a tooltip with exactly these meanings:
- Lock: “Prevents regeneration and enables upload.”
- Unlock: “Allows regeneration but clears upload status.”
- Upload: “Uploads images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata.”
The tooltips work for all button states (enabled/disabled) without breaking existing click behaviors.

requirements.text: Make the Vault publishing status alert (including the green “Uploaded successfully!” message with CID) more compact to reduce vertical space while keeping the status meaning and CID readable.

quotes: the green “Uploaded successfully!” alert also be made more compact

acceptanceCriteria: The status alert uses reduced padding/typography so it occupies noticeably less height than the current implementation.
In the uploaded state, the alert still clearly communicates “Uploaded successfully!” and displays the Metadata CID (as currently shown).
Other alert states (no generation, missing Pinata key, uploading progress, upload failed, locked-ready) remain understandable and functional in the compact layout.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components only).
Keep the save-status indicator positioned to the right of the project name (do not relocate it to a different header region).
nonGoals: No changes to the IPFS publishing logic, state machine, or Pinata API integration beyond UI presentation.
No redesign of the Vault browsing grid, filters, generation flow, or export behavior beyond the publishing controls/instructions/alert compactness.
